name: Tamamo-no-Mae
description: A legendary Japanese nine-tailed fox spirit who, disguised as a beautiful court lady, infiltrated the Heian Imperial court and bewitched the Emperor before being exposed and slain on the Nasu plain.

aliases.name: Hakumen Konmō Kyūbi no Kitsune
aliases.meaning: 'White-Faced Golden-Haired Nine-Tailed Fox' — title used in some otogizōshi

origin: The legend is centered in Japan, with the climactic events on the Nasu plain in modern Tochigi prefecture. Earlier 'lives' of the fox spirit are set in China (Shang court) and India.
